package.name: dpcbf_ros_adapter
package.description: The single seam between ROS2 and the frozen DPCBF library (§10): ObstacleSource with modes oracle/shadow/estimated, a wait-free double-buffered /obstacles_safe subscription with constant-velocity extrapolation and the §10.3 staleness ladder, /dpcbf/status diagnostics, and the T1/T6 filter-I/O capture format. This is the ONLY package that includes both rclcpp and dpcbf headers (§15 rule).
